# Write Primitives merge_date_arithmetic

```{tags} reference, query-template, write_primitives
```

> [Write Primitives](../../write-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Write Primitives queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
MERGE INTO merge_ops_target AS target
USING (
  SELECT
    o_orderkey,
    o_orderdate + INTERVAL '30' DAY AS shifted_date,
    'merge_date_shift' AS marker
  FROM orders
  WHERE o_orderkey BETWEEN 1 AND 50
) AS source
ON target.o_orderkey = source.o_orderkey
WHEN MATCHED THEN
  UPDATE SET o_orderdate = source.shifted_date,
             o_comment = source.marker
```
